avis.titre: Love it but it is too expensive.Love it but it is too expensive.
avis.texte: I love Anthony stuff. It is always well made and I don't mind paying a premium for it. This cleansing water is really good. Micellar waters are all the rage these days and, they should be. It is a more gentle way to cleanse the day off. Anthony ups the game a little bit with the inclusion of witch hazel and sodium PCA that helps with tone, inflammation, and moisturizing all while cleansing. Plus, this stuff is clean. No BS here. That said, while I am usually okay with Anthony's higher prices, this feels a bit too premium. Most good Micellar water costs less than $10 for a good sized bottle. $28, regardless of how well it is made or works, feels heavy to me. I will finish this bottle and see if I can live without it as I just don't feel like adding another recurring $30 bill. However, if the price doesn't bother you, this water from Anthony is really really good. Recommend.

I am in my late 40's with dry, sensitive skin. I have found my skin responds well to micellar water and cleansing oils. I was nervous to try this since it says you don't need to rinse it off, and I thought you always had to rinse micelles. I also worried that witch hazel would be too drying for me. This arrived in a plastic bottle. I wish it were tinted to protect from light damage. There is a small hole to allow the toner to come out. You then wipe it on a cotton round over your face and apply your moisturizer. I was surprised that even when following a good cleanser this would still pick up some grime off my face. It is water thin, and has a slight fragrance although I think it is a natural scent, not added fragrance, and it doesn't bother me at all. I was even more surprised when this didn't dry my face or set off my sensitive skin. No, I didn't find it moisturizing, but I also didn't find it stripping or irritating. I had no negative reactions from my sensitive skin at all.

The Anthony Witch Hazel toner for face has an unpleasant scent IMHO. The cleanser seems to dry out my face. For $28 for 200ml, I think this is overpriced and underperforms. I've tried cheaper toner that works better.
WONDERFUL PRODUCT Your face feels cleaned, toned, and wonderful after using. The product lasts a long time. buy exfoliating cotton pads to use with this and say goodbye to oil and dirt.
No love here. Not even a decent cleaner. Not a bit of mascara run was cleaned off. Rinses off okay. But my face felt filmy after, not clean. If you have oily or trouble skin, give this one a pass.

This is a good micellar. I switch up a lot and am picky with micellar waters. Some just do not work as good or leave the skin feeling as nice. Some also leave me feeling like I need to wash my face again due to residue. I like to try new ones, but the 2 i use most often and regularly are Tarte and Skin Iceland. This one is more of a toner first and then micellar. It makes your skin feel fresh, clean, and soft with no residue left behind. It is not drying. With the witch hazel included it is soothing and can help with irritations or redness you may be having. All around great product.

I’ve been a fan of micellar water for years and I love that this one has witch hazel in it. That being said, witch hazel is not remotely expensive so I don’t understand the price on this. I get they are more of a premium brand, but this should be much less. Regardless, it works well and I will continue to use it as it’s more gentle on my skin when removing makeup. I use it as a second form of cleansing after washing my face or using a face wipe and it always seems to pick up a bit of stuff that was missed. I just wish they’d lower the price.

avis.titre: Nice as a toner/face wash; very little scent.
avis.texte: This is a gender neutral face water/toner. It does a nice job on my dry skin and I always feel clean and fresh faced after using it. Based on the description I expected some scent but there is virtually none. I had to work hard to detect anything at all. I like it quite a bit, good volume which is nice since toner goes fast.
